model_under_test: count_unique(theorem_id where case_type='theorem_case' and observed_verdict='ACCEPT' and passed=true)

comparator_baseline.name: positive_case_total negative control, which counts non-theorem support rows too
comparator_baseline.prediction_rule: Use proof-corpus positive_case_total against the same machine_checked_subset_total aggregate.

uncertainty.metric: absolute residual over one finite proof-corpus aggregate
uncertainty.method: deterministic replay of the pinned Lean/finite-model proof corpus aggregate

negative_controls.description: replace theorem-id aggregate by positive_case_total and require a larger residual

falsifiers: Unique accepted theorem-case count differs from machine_checked_subset_total or broad positive-case control is not worse
